item.title: Protesters attack Ecuador President’s car: Shots fired in alleged assassination attempt; five detained
item.description: Ecuador's President Daniel Noboa narrowly escaped an attack in Cañar province where his motorcade was pelted with rocks by a crowd of 500. Officials reported signs of bullet damage on his vehicle, with five arrests made. The Indigenous federation CONAIE, protesting subsidy cuts, alleged orchestrated violence and arbitrary detentions against their members during the incident.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: California: Diwali becomes state holiday; Indian American community hails move
item.description: California now officially recognizes Diwali as a state holiday. Governor Gavin Newsom signed a new bill into law. This allows public schools and community colleges to close for the festival. State employees can also take paid time off. This bipartisan effort celebrates cultural diversity. California becomes the first West Coast state with this recognition.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: What is Marjorie Taylor Greene ‘disgusted’ about? Complicates GOP’s shutdown pitch, Democrats love it
item.description: Representative Marjorie Taylor Greene has unexpectedly sided with Democrats on extending Obamacare subsidies, criticizing GOP leadership for inaction. Her public stance, despite personal dislike for the program, highlights the subsidies' popularity and creates a significant messaging challenge for Republicans. Greene's intervention undermines the party's position by suggesting their approach is merely lip service.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Peace from…’: Mark Carney praises Donald Trump for India - Pakistan ceasefire; calls him a ‘transformative’ President
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney lauded US President Donald Trump as transformative. Carney cited economic progress and Nato defense increases. He also suggested Trump eased India-Pakistan tensions. India however rejects this, stating the ceasefire followed direct military talks. The conflict began after a terror attack in Jammu and Kashmir. India launched Operation Sindoor in response.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Pam Bondi goes on offensive in senate hearing: Accuses senator Blumenthal of lying; dodges Epstein questions
item.description: US Attorney General Pam Bondi faced intense questioning from Senate Democrats, aggressively deflecting inquiries about Jeffrey Epstein files and her former lobbying firm. She accused Senator Blumenthal of lying about military service and refused to discuss Trump's name in the Epstein documents, citing partisan motives and attacking her interrogators instead.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Real chance’: Donald Trump says Gaza peace deal ‘very close’; talks may reshape wider region
item.description: US President Donald Trump believes a Gaza peace deal is possible. Indirect talks between Hamas and Israeli representatives are underway in Egypt. US negotiators are actively involved in efforts to broker a ceasefire and resolve the broader conflict. The negotiations focus on hostage release and a potential broader regional peace. The plan includes a ceasefire, Hamas disarmament, and Israeli withdrawal.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Tropical storm Jerry: Atlantic’s next hurricane has formed - where is it headed?
item.description: Tropical Storm Jerry has formed in the central Atlantic and is forecast to strengthen into a Category 1 hurricane by Wednesday. The storm is currently moving westward and is expected to track near or north of the Leeward Islands later this week.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: What is the ‘insurrection act’? Trump’s new favourite term - All you need to know about
item.description: President Trump has increasingly used the term "insurrection" to describe protests, suggesting he may invoke the nearly 230-year-old Insurrection Act to deploy troops. This law allows the president to use military force domestically under specific circumstances, bypassing local objections if federal law enforcement is deemed obstructed.

item.description: Ranveer Singh and Deepika Padukone star in Abu Dhabi Tourism’s latest promotional video, which has quickly gained attention for its stunning visuals of Louvre Abu Dhabi and Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque. The video marks their first joint campaign for the emirate, engaging Indian travelers by showcasing Abu Dhabi’s rich culture, family-friendly sites, and warm hospitality.
